name: Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Otemachi
positioning: Luxury hotel on the top six floors of the Otemachi One Tower, next to the Imperial Palace in Tokyo's Otemachi business district
best_for: Travelers who want direct access to Otemachi Station and Imperial Palace views
Diners drawn to Michelin-starred French cuisine at est

facts.text: The hotel occupies the top six floors of the landmark 39-storey Otemachi One Tower.
The hotel has direct access to Otemachi Station.
est is the hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant.
PIGNETO is the hotel's Italian restaurant, on the 39th floor.
VIRTÙ is a cocktail bar on the 39th floor.
The spa has five treatment rooms.
The hotel has a 20-metre indoor heated pool.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: The hotel offers panoramic views of the cityscape, the Imperial Palace and Gardens, and Mount Fuji in the distance.
PIGNETO has an outdoor terrazza that faces the Imperial Palace Gardens and Tokyo cityscapes.
The guest rooms and suites are designed by Jean-Michel Gathy of DENNISTON and DESIGN STUDIO SPIN.
est uses 95% locally sourced ingredients from across Japan.
Steam rooms and ofuro (Japanese baths) are available in both locker rooms.

considerations.text: Reception is on the 39th floor, reached by an elevator inside the Otemachi One entrance.
The hotel is in Otemachi, which the hotel calls Tokyo's most important business district.
Children ages 15 and under are welcome in the swimming pool from 9:00 am to 6:30 pm.
WhataHotel notes the business district setting may feel less culturally immersive than traditional neighborhoods.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
